prompt: A high-end street style fashion photography shot, capturing two confident twin models in their late 20s walking down a European cobblestone street. The street is lined with blurred luxury boutiques and outdoor cafes. The models are styled identically: wearing an oversized, heavily distressed blue denim jacket worn off-the-shoulder, a black asymmetric corset-style top with lace-up details, a high-waisted navy blue pleated micro-miniskirt over black cycling shorts, and sleek black leather knee-high boots. They accessorize with bold, chunky gold chain necklaces and bracelets, and classic black cat-eye designer sunglasses. Each carries a small black designer handbag with gold hardware (one has a gold chain strap, the other a black leather strap). The models are walking in unison, one slightly ahead of the other, creating a dynamic composition. The lighting is diffused daylight, perfect for fashion editorial. The depth of field is shallow, keeping the models in sharp focus while the background is a beautiful bokeh blur of the city. Professional, cinematic grading. Canon EOS R5

promptZh: 一张高端街头风时尚摄影作品，捕捉了 两位自信的双胞胎模特（20 多岁）走在 欧洲鹅卵石街道 上的画面。街道两旁是模糊的奢华精品店和露天咖啡馆。模特穿着相同的服饰：一件 超大廓形、做旧感强烈的蓝色牛仔夹克，采用露肩穿法；内搭黑色不对称紧身胸衣式上衣，带有系带细节；下身穿着海军蓝高腰百褶超短裙，内搭黑色骑行短裤；脚踩时髦的黑色皮革及膝长靴。她们佩戴着醒目的粗金链项链和手链，以及经典的黑色猫眼设计师太阳镜。每人手提一个小巧的黑色设计师手袋，配有金色五金件（一个配有金链肩带，另一个配有黑色皮质肩带）。模特们并肩行走，一人略微靠前，构图极具动态感。光线为柔和的自然光，非常适合时尚大片。景深较浅，使模特保持清晰对焦，背景呈现出美丽的城市虚化效果。专业电影级调色。Canon EOS R5
